_comment: The converter's expansions (the launcher's Converter screen lists them in this order). `id` is the Map table's ExpansionID; `build` is wago.tools' build the files and tables are taken from (Legion 7.3.5.26972 is the client the Legion version of the launcher plays; Cataclysm Classic is the tool's own pin); `with_revamped`: also the maps 3.3.5a has that the expansion made over (the Cataclysm continents). A build wago.tools does not serve is the first thing a run says.
